Definition: properly, a hider, i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion
BiblicalUsage: Master is the hiding, the turning away of the face, and it appears once, in Isaiah 53:3, where the suffering servant was despised and we hid as it were our faces from him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse convicts me: I hid my face from Him, and He still bore my griefs.
